pages.title: File:Casualties are evacuated after VC bombing of the Caravelle Hotel.jpg

ObjectName.value: Casualties are evacuated after VC bombing of the Caravelle Hotel

ImageDescription.value:
On 25 August 1964 in the center of Saigon, an explosion partially destroyed the fourth, fifth and sixth floors of the Caravelle Hotel. No one was killed but six were injured in the explosion believed to have been planted by Vietcong agents. Two Vietnamese policemen help an American soldier who was injured in the explosion.
NARA 111-CCV-56-CC27585
